Recipe names are prefixed '[JBUK]' and some carry option tags in brackets. TRAP: the Brand column lists the sites for site-specific rows (462 rows blank = all sites; 44 rows [ILFORD][MANCHESTER][BRADFORD], 29 [Reading], 5 [KINGSWAY GOLF CENTRE], a few Chelmsford/Rushden/Richmond/Telford/Wednesbury), so menus differ by site: publish only blank-site rows or dishes that agree at 2 or more sites. A script reads this with csv.DictReader.
